name: 销售与外部采购商的集成 (2EL)
name_en: Integration of Sales with External Buyers (2EL)
description_en_html:
Overview

For selling organizations whose buyers use traditional data exchange protocols such as electronic data interchange (EDI), or in two-tier scenarios, where subsidiaries are on SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, this scope item provides a set of robust application programming interfaces (APIs) to simplify and automate exchanging sales documents and their follow-on messages.

The following documents and functions are supported:

Sales Process:

  • Create, change, or cancel sales order (inbound message)
  • Send purchase order confirmation (outbound message)
  • Send Advance Shipping Notification (ASN, outbound delivery message)
  • Send supplier invoice (outbound message)

Return Process:

  • Create return order (inbound message)
  • Return order confirmation (outbound message)
  • Send Credit Memo (outbound message)

The Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) messaging protocol is supported.

You can enable B2B integration with the corresponding Integration of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Procurement with Suppliers (2EJ) scope item.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, update, or cancel sales order from purchase order
  • Display sales order (optional)
  • Release or cancel sales order manually if customer-expected price check fails
  • Send order (cancellation) confirmation
  • Create delivery
  • Execute picking
  • Post goods issue
  • Send advance shipping notice
  • Create billing document
  • Send invoice
  • Perform customer return process

Business Benefits

  • Experience greater automation in exchanging sales documents with buyers
  • Reduce time and manual efforts in corresponding with buyers
  • Increase productivity, performance, and work satisfaction of sales professionals and accounts receivable accountants
  • Save costs for paper, postage, mailing, records management
  • Enable higher degrees of scalability with process efficiency gains
description_zh_html:
概览

对于采购商使用电子数据互换 (EDI) 等传统数据交换协议的销售组织，或者在子公司位于 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 的两层场景中，此范围项目提供了一组强大的应用程序编程接口 (API)，以简化和自动化交换销售凭证及其后续消息。

支持以下凭证和功能：

销售流程：

  • 创建、更改或取消销售订单（入库消息）
  • 发送采购订单确认（出库消息）
  • 发送提前装运通知（ASN，出库交货消息）
  • 发送供应商发票（出库消息）

退货流程：

  • 创建退货订单（入库消息）
  • 退货订单确认（出库消息）
  • 发送贷项凭证（出库消息）

支持简单对象访问协议 (SOAP) 消息传递协议。

您可以通过相应的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 采购与供应商的集成 (2EJ) 范围项目启用 B2B 集成。

关键流程流

  • 根据采购订单创建、更新或取消销售订单
  • 显示销售订单（可选）
  • 如果客户预期价格检查失败，则手动下达或取消销售订单
  • 发送订单（取消）确认
  • 创建交货
  • 执行拣配
  • 过账发货
  • 发送提前装运通知
  • 创建开票凭证
  • 发送发票
  • 执行客户退货流程

业务优势

  • 在与采购商交换销售凭证时体验更大的自动化
  • 减少与采购商相对应的时间和手动工作量
  • 提高销售专家和应收账款会计人员的生产力、绩效和工作满意度
  • 节省纸张、邮费、邮寄、记录管理成本
  • 提高流程效率，提高可扩展性
